name: jengo/auth
description: Unified Authentication and Authorization Engine for CodeIgniter 4 and the Jengo Framework, powered by Vima.

services.name: auth
services.description: Primary authentication and identity manager providing fluent auth checks, credential verification, token generation, and response dispatching.

services.name: vima
services.description: Underlying Vima access control manager providing RBAC, ABAC policies, explicit denies, and audit logging.

guards.description: Base contract for authentication drivers. Developers can register custom drivers via auth()->extend('name', fn() => new CustomGuard()) or Config/Auth.php ($guards mapping).
Auto-detects Bearer tokens for APIs and falls back to session cookies and encrypted remember-me tokens for web.
Stateful session authenticator with remember-me cookie recall.
Stateless Personal Access Token authenticator supporting token hashing and ability checks.

forms.description: FormHandler for login attempts with identifier resolution and remember-me parsing.
FormHandler for registration validation with confirmation checks and email normalization.
FormHandler for password reset request validation.
FormHandler for new password submissions with token and confirmation matching.
FormHandler for magic link request validation.

response_handling.description: Centralized response orchestrator scaffolding active ResponseModifier detection, 404 masked responses, 422 validation failure generation, and jengo.form.failed event handling.

modifiers.description: Default modifier rendering traditional CodeIgniter 4 HTML view templates and standard 302 flash redirects.
API modifier returning structured REST API JSON responses ({status, message, data, user}).
SPA modifier returning Inertia::render() components and Inertia redirects with shared props.

actions.description: Two-factor authentication challenge sending a time-sensitive 6-digit verification code via email.
Post-registration account activation challenge verifying the user's email before granting active status.

notifiers.description: Contract for pluggable notification dispatchers. Allows external queueing or third-party email/SMS providers without modifying controllers.
Built-in email sender using CodeIgniter's email service and responsive HTML templates.
In-memory notification sink for unit testing and local inspection.

controllers.description: Single-responsibility login and logout controller using #[Validate(LoginFormHandler::class)].
Post-auth action controller (e.g. 2FA/MFA) enforcing strict 404 responses on failures.
Personal access token lifecycle management controller.

rate_limiting.description: Multi-signal rate limiter that keys authenticated requests by user_id, and guests by target account, IP address, and browser/device fingerprint.

attributes.description: Requires an authenticated user session or token.
Requires an unauthenticated guest (redirects authenticated users to home).
Requires the user to possess specific Vima roles.
Requires the user to pass a Vima permission or ABAC policy check.

setup_providers.description: Setup classes implementing get(): array returning permissions (via Permission::define('name', 'description')) and roles (via Role::define('name', 'description')->withPermissions([...])) synced into DB via 'php spark vima:sync'.

commands.description: Imports users, password hashes, and identities from CodeIgniter Shield into Jengo Auth and Vima.
Runs interactive setup for Auth & Vima, publishing configs, setup classes, and registering routes.
Synchronizes roles, hierarchy, and permissions defined in app/Libraries/Vima/Setup.php into the database.
Generates PHP permission/role mapper classes and TypeScript definition maps for frontend auto-completion.

helpers.name: vima
helpers.description: Access the global Vima authorization manager.

helpers.name: can
helpers.description: Check if current user can perform permission or pass policy.

helpers.name: can_any
helpers.description: Check if current user has any of the given permissions.

helpers.name: can_all
helpers.description: Check if current user has all of the given permissions.

routing.description: Advanced route publishing with support for prefix/grouping, paths customization, only/except flow filtering, controller overrides, route name prefixes, and route filters.
